row.title: Pilot offer is data; no price is published without a measured cost
row.body: doctrine/pilot-offer.json holds the four system-test questions, what the pilot includes and a price block whose monthly_usd and range_usd stay null until a measured cost supports a figure. The offer reaches /pilot through site/dashboard-data.js (pilot_offer) so the dashboard freshness check covers it, and site/site.test.mjs fails when the page and the file differ. claimcode flags words such as always, never and every on public surfaces, including generated data.
